promptText: Which hotel brands are commonly considered for a hotel with branded residences component in Mexico?

payload.rawResponseText:
In Mexico, hotel-branded residences are overwhelmingly concentrated in the **luxury and ultra-luxury segments**. A practical developer/operator long list would typically include the following:

### Core brands most often shortlisted

| Brand | Typical positioning | Best fit in Mexico |
|---|---|---|
| **Four Seasons** | Established ultra-luxury; strong residential platform | Los Cabos, Punta Mita/Riviera Nayarit, Riviera Maya |
| **The Ritz-Carlton / Ritz-Carlton Reserve** | Globally recognized luxury with strong Marriott distribution | Urban towers and high-end beach resorts |
| **St. Regis** | Formal, service-led luxury with strong buyer recognition | Mexico City, Los Cabos, Riviera Maya, Punta Mita |
| **Rosewood** | Ultra-luxury, design- and destination-oriented | Low-density resorts and heritage-oriented urban projects |
| **One&Only** | Highly exclusive resort villas and private homes | Low-density coastal or nature-led destinations |
| **Aman** | Top-end privacy, wellness and limited inventory | Exceptional, secluded resort sites |
| **Auberge Resorts Collection** | Experiential luxury with a strong Mexico resort record | Los Cabos, Punta Mita and boutique resort communities |
| **Montage** | Ultra-luxury resort and residential model | Los Cabos and other high-end coastal destinations |

These brands have direct Mexican precedents: Four Seasons operates residential products in Los Cabos and Punta Mita; Rosewood has residences at Mayakoba; One&Only has Private Homes at Mandarina; Auberge operates Chileno Bay Resort & Residences; Montage has a residential component in Los Cabos; and Aman opened Amanvari with Mexico’s first Aman residences in August 2026. ([fourseasons.com](https://www.fourseasons.com/regional-collections/mexico-travel/?utm_source=openai))

### Strong luxury and lifestyle alternatives

- **Park Hyatt** — especially credible for sophisticated resort or urban projects; Park Hyatt Los Cabos includes residences.
- **W Hotels** — appropriate for younger, design-conscious resort or urban buyers.
- **EDITION** — suitable for design-led urban or resort projects with a strong food-and-beverage component.
- **Pendry** — contemporary luxury; particularly relevant for Mexico City and lifestyle resort markets. Pendry Mexico City includes 20 residences, while Pendry Punta Mita is planned with 32.
- **Waldorf Astoria** — traditional ultra-luxury backed by Hilton; residential projects have been announced for Guadalajara and San Miguel de Allende.
- **Fairmont** — well suited to larger family resorts, golf communities and mixed-use developments; already established residentially at Mayakoba.
- **Banyan Tree** — resort and wellness-oriented, particularly relevant to Riviera Maya-type locations.
- **Six Senses** — wellness and sustainability positioning; Six Senses Xala is listed as a forthcoming Mexican residential project.
- **Thompson Hotels** — lifestyle positioning, generally appropriate for urban or younger coastal buyers.
- **SLS** — design, entertainment and nightlife-led positioning, generally more appropriate for urban or high-energy resort markets. ([parkhyattloscabosresidences.com](https://www.parkhyattloscabosresidences.com/residences-and-villas?utm_source=openai))

## Typical shortlist by project type

**Ultra-luxury resort villas**
- Aman
- Four Seasons
- Rosewood
- One&Only
- Ritz-Carlton Reserve
- Auberge
- Montage

**Luxury resort condominiums or mixed-use resorts**
- St. Regis
- Ritz-Carlton
- Park Hyatt
- Fairmont
- Waldorf Astoria
- W
- Pendry
- Banyan Tree

**Urban branded residences**
- Ritz-Carlton
- St. Regis
- Waldorf Astoria
- Park Hyatt
- Pendry
- EDITION
- W
- Thompson

**Wellness or environmentally sensitive destinations**
- Six Senses
- Aman
- Rosewood
- One&Only
- Banyan Tree

Mexico’s branded-residence market is now broad—more than 50 brands across 96 identified projects—but remains concentrated: 16 brands reportedly account for more than 75% of units, and approximately 81% of identified projects use hospitality brands. ([hosteltur.com](https://www.hosteltur.com/176652_branded-residences-en-mexico-mucho-volumen-pero-pocos-jugadores-grandes.html))

The final brand shortlist should be determined by **location, achievable residential pricing, unit count, buyer profile, hotel key count, rental-program strategy, brand fees, territorial availability and the developer’s ability to meet brand design and service standards**. For most high-end Mexican resort projects, I would begin with **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton/Reserve, St. Regis, Rosewood, One&Only, Auberge, Montage and Park Hyatt**, then add Aman, Waldorf Astoria, Fairmont, Pendry or Six Senses according to the specific positioning.
